mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION ( account_id, fingerprint, transaction_category, loan_transaction_type_name, tran_date, tran_time, out_amount, in_amount, loan_principal_amount, loan_interest_amount, after_balance, desc1, desc2, desc3, desc4 ) VALUES
(#{tx.accountId}, #{tx.fingerprint}, #{tx.transactionCategory}, #{tx.loanTransactionTypeName}, #{tx.tranDate}, #{tx.tranTime}, #{tx.outAmount}, #{tx.inAmount}, #{tx.loanPrincipalAmount}, #{tx.loanInterestAmount}, #{tx.afterBalance}, #{tx.desc1}, #{tx.desc2}, #{tx.desc3}, #{tx.desc4})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE desc1 = COALESCE(VALUES(desc1), desc1), loan_transaction_type_name = COALESCE(VALUES(loan_transaction_type_name), loan_transaction_type_name), loan_principal_amount = COALESCE(VALUES(loan_principal_amount), loan_principal_amount), loan_interest_amount = COALESCE(VALUES(loan_interest_amount), loan_interest_amount)
mapper.select: SELECT account_transaction_id AS id, account_id AS accountId, fingerprint, transaction_category AS transactionCategory, loan_transaction_type_name AS loanTransactionTypeName, tran_date AS tranDate, tran_time AS tranTime, out_amount AS outAmount, in_amount AS inAmount, loan_principal_amount AS loanPrincipalAmount, loan_interest_amount AS loanInterestAmount, after_balance AS afterBalance, desc1, desc2, desc3, desc4, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND tran_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY tran_date, tran_time, account_transaction_id
